theme: Dark premium with gold accents / Light minimalist with colorful accent

rules: Use font-light for large headings to create a premium, editorial feel.
No full-screen gradients. Use solid colors with subtle borders.
Never use pure black (#000000) or pure grey. Always use zinc (cool grey).
Primary color should be used sparingly for CTAs and key highlights.

surfaces.sidebar: Solid background matching theme, 1px border on the right (border-border).
surfaces.header: Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/70 with a delicate 1px border on the bottom.
surfaces.cards: Flat background with 1px subtle border. No shadow in dark mode. Soft shadow-sm in light mode.
surfaces.ai_elements: The 'Tracing Beam' or subtle glow effect for AI smart photo selection features.

borders_and_radius.radius: rounded-xl for cards, rounded-full for pill buttons.
borders_and_radius.borders: 1px crisp borders to expose the grid skeleton (Technical Look).

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_structure: Fixed left sidebar (w-64) + Main content area. Mobile: Hamburger menu opening a sheet.
grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: Generous spacing. Use p-6, p-8, and p-12. Avoid cramped layouts.

bento_grid.items: Summary cards col-span-1, Charts col-span-2 row-span-2, Feed/Lists col-span-1 row-span-2.

grids_and_layouts.alignment: Left-align paragraphs, inputs, and dense data. Center-align empty states or hero headers only.

components.buttons: Modern pill-shaped or slightly rounded (rounded-lg). Explicit hover states (e.g., hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-transform).
components.inputs: Shadcn UI base, customized with h-11 or h-12 for larger tap targets. Subtle borders.
components.photo_gallery: Masonry grid with group-hover effects. Image overlay max bg-black/40 to ensure image remains visible.
components.ai_badge: Small pill with an icon (Sparkles), glowing border to indicate AI-selected photos.
components.tables: Shadcn UI table for CRM and Financials. Dense spacing, left-aligned, sticky headers.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: All interactive elements must change state (color + slight transform).
motion_and_interaction.transitions: Use specific properties: transition-colors, transition-transform duration-200 ease-in-out. DO NOT use transition-all.
motion_and_interaction.loading: Use skeleton loaders matching card shapes. No generic spinners for main content.
motion_and_interaction.animations: Framer motion for staggered list reveals in the photo gallery.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has sufficient contrast (use text-shadow or gradient overlays).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='upload-photo-btn').

media_and_images.rules: No placeholder URLs. Use provided high-quality images. Images must not exceed 80vh on mobile.

3d_and_creative_libraries.icons: lucide-react (default) or @phosphor-icons/react for a premium duotone look.
3d_and_creative_libraries.charts: recharts (Shadcn chart component) for financial and session analytics.
3d_and_creative_libraries.animations: framer-motion for micro-interactions and layout transitions.
3d_and_creative_libraries.toasts: sonner for all notifications (e.g., 'Fatura enviada', 'Fotos selecionadas pela IA').

instructions_to_main_agent: Design MUST include a Dark Mode (Premium Gold) and Light Mode (Minimalist Violet) toggle.
Implement the UI in Portuguese (Portugal). E.g., 'Dashboard', 'Clientes', 'Projetos', 'Galerias', 'Calendário', 'Financeiro'.
DO NOT use a completely transparent background for the header. Always use a blur or solid color.
Use pure HTML + Tailwind for complex, custom overlapping layouts (like photo masonry), and Shadcn for logic-heavy components (Forms, Tables, Dialogs).
Add 'data-testid' to ALL buttons, links, and form inputs.
Use a generous spacing scale. Add internal padding to containers with borders to prevent text collision.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
